criteria.criterion: The change records, in docs/decisions.md or the commit message, why commit 64ecdc9 carries the records of job 20261010-131714-adcd while its Athena-Job trailer names 20261010-132713-ezm8, citing the evidence (git show output, code path). It says whether a bug in the landing or records-staging code caused it.
criteria.evidence: D61's 'Open, not resolved' paragraph says the cause 'is not established'. The producer could not run git show, and the code reading is 'a finding from reading, not a proof'. No cause is recorded. I also could not inspect the commit: here `git show 64ecdc9` fails with 'unknown revision', because this copy holds only the base and candidate commits.

criteria.criterion: If the cause is a code bug, it is fixed in the code with a regression test that fails without the fix.
criteria.evidence: No cause was found, so this criterion cannot be judged met. The change touches no landing or records-staging code: land.rs and commits.rs are unchanged, and run.rs only gains the new check.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo run -- check --history` from the repository root. It exits 0 and reports no violation for the 64ecdc9 commit. Check that the command actually builds and runs, and say so in the output.
criteria.evidence: The literal command exits 101 with 'could not determine which binary to run. ... available binaries: athena, xtask'. The candidate did not make it run (for example with a default-run key); it only documents this in D61. With `--bin athena` the command builds and runs, but exits 2 with 2 violations on this two-commit copy, and 64ecdc9 is not in this history at all. This is the same 'acceptance command didn't run' fault the first try was rejected for.

criteria.criterion: If the real commit needs an exemption, athena.toml [history] exempt adds the full 40-character id of 64ecdc9 (found with git log or git show), never a prefix. athena.toml is named as a governance deliverable. If the cause is a bug that can be fixed without an exemption, no exemption is added.
criteria.evidence: athena.toml is unchanged. There is no exemption and no fix, so the 64ecdc9 violation the request asks to clear is still unresolved. No prefix exemption was added, which is correct as far as it goes.

criteria.criterion: Verification of a candidate that changes the gate (crates/athena-gate, or the check, land or verify paths that call it) runs the history check with the candidate's own freshly built gate, not the compiled-in one. A candidate whose gate fails the history check cannot land as verified.
criteria.evidence: In run.rs (lines 643-661), after the capability's checks, `run_candidate_history` runs when the changed paths match GATE_PATHS. It runs `cargo run --locked --quiet --bin athena --manifest-path <vsnap>/Cargo.toml -- check --history` with the user's repository as the working directory, and the run is added to check_runs. Any failed check makes judge() return fail.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`. Both pass. New tests cover (a) a gate-changing candidate whose gate fails the history check being refused and (b) a passing one being accepted.
criteria.evidence: I did not run these myself. Athena ran `cargo test --locked` (220 tests passed) and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` (passed) on this tree. The new tests in checks.rs, `a_gate_candidate_whose_own_gate_fails_the_history_check_is_refused` and `..._passes_..._is_accepted`, cover both cases, using a stub shell command in place of the real build.
I did not run this myself. Athena ran `cargo fmt --all --check` on this tree and it passed.

criteria.criterion: docs/enforcement.md gets a row for the new mechanism, linking its blocking and passing tests. CHANGELOG.md notes the change.
criteria.evidence: Row M30 is added and names the blocking and passing tests. CHANGELOG.md has a new entry citing D61.

Behavior criterion 7 is unmet: its evidence must cite commands that ran (D43)
The root cause of 64ecdc9's mismatch is not found, and the history check still fails on it
findings.evidence: D61 says the cause 'is not established'. The change adds no fix and no exemption, so the main ask ('make it pass on our real history') is not done. This repeats the first try's 'never found why' fault.

findings.summary: The acceptance command `cargo run -- check --history` does not run
findings.evidence: It exits 101 with 'could not determine which binary to run'. This repeats the first try's 'acceptance command didn't run' fault. The candidate documented the failure instead of fixing it.

findings.summary: Every gate change will now fail verification until 64ecdc9 is resolved
findings.evidence: The new check runs over the real history, which (per the request) still fails on 64ecdc9. Because the cause is left unfixed, every gate-changing candidate, including a fix for this same problem, will be refused.

findings.summary: The tests do not exercise the run.rs wiring or a real candidate build
findings.evidence: The tests pass a `sh -c` script in place of the cargo command and call judge() directly. A regression in the run.rs integration (the dir, the manifest path, or the all-passed condition) would not be caught.

summary: This change fails. It adds a working mechanism, but it does not do the main thing the request asked for. When a candidate changes the gate, verification now builds the candidate's own gate and runs `check --history` through it, and a failure there blocks verification. Tests, a docs/enforcement.md row and a CHANGELOG entry come with it. But the change never finds why commit 64ecdc9 carries job adcd's records under job ezm8's trailer: D61 says the cause is not established. It adds neither a fix nor an exemption, so the history check still fails on that commit. The required acceptance command `cargo run -- check --history` stops with 'could not determine which binary to run' (I ran it). The first try was rejected for two of these same faults: the root cause was never found, and the acceptance command did not run. With 64ecdc9 left unresolved, the new check will also refuse every future gate change, including any fix for this problem.
